attempts.summary: Set up a nightly cron-driven backup on node1 (via /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh, crontab entry "0 2 * * *") that rsyncs /srv/inventory/data from node2 over SSH pubkey auth into dated directories under /var/backups/inventory on node1 (e.g. 2026-09-03/), and prunes dated directories older than 7 days. Verified functionally by running the script manually, seeding 8 synthetic old-dated directories, and confirming all 8 were pruned on the next run while the current day's backup and checksums matched the source. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on both node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming boot_id changes and full recovery of services (crond/sshd), cron configuration, backup data, and inter-node SSH connectivity/backup functionality after each restart.
